intro: Physics from the ground up, one topic at a time: explanations, plots, animations and worked exercises. This is the book I'm writing, published here as the chapters are ready.

levels.name: Movement
levels.blurb: How things move: position, velocity, acceleration, and motion in two dimensions.

chapters.title: Motion in one dimension
chapters.summary: Rewsna on a straight road: position, velocity and acceleration, derivatives and integrals.

chapters.title: Projectile motion
chapters.summary: Split the motion in two and a thrown ball becomes easy.

levels.name: Forces and Energy
levels.blurb: Why things move the way they do, and the quantity that is never lost.

levels.name: Thermodynamics
levels.blurb: Heat, temperature and the laws that govern energy in motion.

levels.name: Electromagnetism
levels.blurb: Charges, fields and light as an electromagnetic wave.

chapters.title: Polarisation of light
chapters.summary: The hidden direction of light, Malus's law and the Stokes parameters.

levels.name: Quantum Mechanics
levels.blurb: The strange rules of the very small.

levels.name: Exploring the Sky
levels.blurb: The physics behind what we see when we look up.

chapters.title: Rayleigh scattering
chapters.summary: Why the sky is blue and polarised, derived from a tiny oscillating dipole.
